newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-CHAMPIONS SPARTAK BACK IN FIRST PLACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHAMPIONS SPARTAK BACK IN FIRST PLACE.

text.p: Champions Spartak Moscow regained top spot in the Russian league from city rivals Dynamo after they beat Lokomotiv Nizhny Novgorod 1-0 on Saturday.
Dynamo Moscow were held 0-0 in Yaroslavl and dropped to third.
Spartak, who sneaked home with a lone goal by Yegor Titov in the second half, now lead second-placed Rotor, who crushed Tyumen 5-2 in Volgograd, by one point.
